plain.li: A year ago I'd never heard of this place. Now I know which floorboard creaks.
Another year. I've stopped counting the raids and started counting the people still here.
When I arrived I gave it a month. Shows what I know.
[old] I've lived in a lot of places. This is the one I'll be buried in. I've made my peace with that.
[newcomer] Still feels new. Less every day.
[winter] Snow again. Same as the day I got here, more or less.
[grieving] I'd like to celebrate. Not everyone who was here a year ago got to.
[lowtech] Another year of fire and stone. I've grown to like both.

warm.li: I came here with nothing. Now I have all of you. Not a bad trade.
Thank you for keeping me around. I mean it.

blunt.li: Another year. Still hate the rice. Still here.
Don't make a fuss. Fine, a small fuss.

cheerful.li: Happy anniversary to ME! I'm accepting gifts, compliments and extra dessert!
Best year yet! Well, the only years I've had here, but still the best!

gloomy.li: One more year survived. The odds keep getting worse, but here I am.
I didn't expect to last this long. I'm not sure how I feel about it.

cold.li: Another year of tenure. My contribution has been substantial. Noted, I hope.
